offlineGuide.officeName: PMC Road Department / Nearest Ward Junior Engineer Office
offlineGuide.officeAddress: PMC Main Building, Shivajinagar, Pune - 411005 (Or local Ward Office at Kothrud, Aundh, Hadapsar, Viman Nagar)
documentsToCarry: 2 printed color photographs showing defect with identifiable landmark
Printed formal grievance application letter addressed to Junior Engineer (Roads)
Government photo ID (Voter ID / Driving License) for visitor register
offlineGuide.bestTimeToVisit: 10:30 AM - 1:00 PM (Monday to Friday, when Junior & Deputy Engineers are available before site visits)
offlineGuide.whatToSay: I am here to register an urgent road hazard grievance under the PMC Citizen's Charter 72-hour SLA. This defect creates an immediate skidding and accident risk for two-wheelers. Please stamp my duplicate copy with the ward in-ward acknowledgment number.

onlineFilingSteps: Visit PMC Care (complaint.punecorporation.org) or download the PMC Care Mobile App.
Select 'Roads & Traffic' -> 'Pothole / Road Repair' category.
Upload geotagged photo, landmark name, and nearest ward office.
Submit to obtain an official PMC tracking token (e.g. PMC-2026-XXXX).

offlineGuide.officeAddress: Drainage Dept, 3rd Floor, PMC New Annex Building, Shivajinagar, Pune
documentsToCarry: Printed grievance letter detailing sewage contamination and public health risk
Photographs showing overflowing manhole or choked chamber adjacent to property
Photo ID
offlineGuide.bestTimeToVisit: Round the clock for emergency hazards; 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM for Sub-Divisional Engineer meetings
offlineGuide.whatToSay: I am reporting an acute sewage chamber overflow at [Location]. It is a critical vector-borne disease and health hazard. Under PMC Emergency SLA, this requires immediate suction tanker dispatch within 24 hours.

onlineFilingSteps: Go to complaint.punecorporation.org or use PMC WhatsApp Grievance Bot (+91 96899 00002).
Send 'Drainage Emergency' with precise location and photo.
Mark 'Open Manhole' if hazardous to trigger immediate 6-hour emergency dispatch.
Receive SMS tracking with Junior Engineer assigned contact number.

offlineOfficeDetails.headOffice: Drainage Dept, 3rd Floor, PMC New Annex Building, Shivajinagar
offlineOfficeDetails.timings: 24x7 Emergency Drainage Control Room operates round the clock.
documentsToCarry: Printed complaint citing public health risk (Dengue/Malaria hazard)
Exact building/society adjacent address

offlineGuide.officeAddress: Respective Ward Health Office (Aundh, Kothrud, Sinhagad Road, etc.)
documentsToCarry: Photographs showing chronic garbage accumulation or illegal open burning
Petition letter signed by neighboring residents or society secretary
offlineGuide.bestTimeToVisit: 8:30 AM - 11:00 AM (Sanitary Inspectors conduct morning field visits before 11:30 AM)
offlineGuide.whatToSay: This spot has become an illegal chronic dumping point attracting stray dogs and cattle. We request immediate clearance by SWaCH collection vehicles and placement of a dedicated municipal bin.

onlineFilingSteps: Use Swachhata-MoHUA App or PMC Care Web Portal.
Snap picture of chronic dump (Chroni Spot / Kachra Kundi).
Tag locality (e.g., Baner Balewadi Phata / Viman Nagar Datta Mandir Chowk).
Sanitation Inspector (SI) is dispatched with SWaCH collection vehicle.

offlineOfficeDetails.headOffice: Solid Waste Management Cell, PMC Annex Building, Shivajinagar
offlineOfficeDetails.timings: Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM (Sanitation Inspectors available before 11 AM)
documentsToCarry: Written petition signed by residents/society secretary if recurrent chronic spot
Photographs showing commercial debris or unsegregated dumping

offlineGuide.bestTimeToVisit: 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM for Section Engineer; 24/7 Breakdown desk for emergency sparking
offlineGuide.whatToSay: I am reporting a severe electrical hazard with exposed conductors / non-functioning streetlights on [Street]. This poses an electrocution danger and endangers pedestrians at night.

onlineFilingSteps: For streetlights: Dial PMC Toll Free 1800 1030 222 or log on complaint.punecorporation.org under 'Electrical Department'.
For exposed live wires / transformer sparks: Call Mahavitaran emergency 1912 immediately.
Provide Pole Number (painted in yellow on PMC poles, e.g. KOT-142) and street name.

offlineGuide.officeName: Executive Engineer Office, Water Supply Division
offlineGuide.officeAddress: Chaturshringi Water Works Office, Senapati Bapat Road or Parvati Water Works
documentsToCarry: Clear photograph of bursting pipeline or muddy water sample in clean bottle
Copy of recent PMC Property Tax / Water bill index number
offlineGuide.bestTimeToVisit: 11:00 AM - 1:30 PM (When Executive Engineers examine daily water distribution logs)
offlineGuide.whatToSay: Clean drinking municipal water is gushing onto the road causing immense water loss and road damage. We request urgent valve isolation and pipeline repair squad dispatch.

onlineFilingSteps: Register on PMC Care under 'Water Supply' -> 'Main Pipeline Leakage / Contamination'.
Specify if water is visibly muddy, emitting foul smell, or gushing onto roadway.
Water Quality Inspection squad will be assigned within 12 hours.

offlineOfficeDetails.timings: 24x7 Water breakdown desk. Executive Engineers available 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM.
documentsToCarry: Water sample in clean transparent bottle if contamination is reported
Property tax index number / society registration
